newsitem.title: CROATIA: Blaze on Croat holiday isle extinguished.
newsitem.headline: Blaze on Croat holiday isle extinguished.

text.p: Croatian firemen helped by police helicopters and fire-fighting planes on Thursday put out a huge blaze that had raged for three days on popular Adriatic resort of Hvar island, state radio reported.
"The battle with the fire is won," reported a radio correspondent from Hvar, a summer resort packed with tourists from eastern and western Europe.

The fire, which broke out in the centre of Hvar on Monday, destroyed over 3,000 hectares (7,400 acres) of pine forests, vineyards and olive groves and threatened several towns on the isle, advertised as "Croatia's sunniest island".
